text:
Micaela: Heads-up — noticed a small burst (~150 requests over 2m) where paid EU tenants got routed to us-east instead of eu-west. Looks like it only hit customers on `tier:enterprise`. Notable spike in cross-region egress. Anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

Jon: seeing the same in logs. no obvious infra flaps. can you paste an example request id?

Micaela: req id 6f3b2e7a. stack snippets attached below (headers + routing decision). suspect fallback->variant mapping may be region-agnostic.

Ravi: quick grep of the policy repo shows a fallback rule that matches enterprise with a generic variant:```yaml
- match: { tier: enterprise, model: xlarge-v2 }
  action: fallback_to: xlarge-v1
  route_policy: { region: any, priority: fallback }
```
that `region: any` is likely the culprit — when eu-west pool is constrained, it picks any region.

Lia: that fallback was added during the last capacity incident to avoid 503s. we probably didn't pin the fallback variants to the same geo. short-term mitigation: disable cross-region fallback for `tier:enterprise` so they either queue or hit a local lower-capacity variant.

Micaela: Agreed. can someone hotpatch the policy to set `route_policy.region: same` or add a hard deny for cross-region egress for enterprise? I'll open a quick rollout in console.

DeployBot: started rollout job #rb-hotpatch-908 to update routing policy for enterprise fallback. targeting control-plane config, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

Jon: also recommend adding a telemetry counter for "fallback_hop_count" and a tag `cross_region=true` so we can alarm if > 5/min per region.

Ravi: hotpatch note: updating rule to:```yaml
route_policy: { region: same, priority: fallback, max_hops: 1 }
```
will push now and keep a short TTL so we can revert if it misbehaves.

OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2028-762. Summary: unexpected cross-region routing for enterprise tier caused by region-agnostic fallback variant. Severity: P2.

DeployBot: rollout at 5% completed, no errors.

Micaela: thanks. once we confirm reduced cross-region egress, let's follow up with a Console UX improvement: make fallback region-scope explicit in the rollout modal (show risk of cross-region). opening an RFC.

Lia: adding a follow-up task for evals team to run quality checks on the pinned same-region fallback variant (ensure output parity).

Jon: quick follow-up: add an alert to the routing dashboard that surfaces sudden shifts in "local to remote" routing ratio by tier. even a small absolute number matters for compliance-sensitive tenants.

Ravi: pushed the change, canaries look clean. cross-region count for the tenant set dropped to 0 in the past 90s.

Micaela: closing the loop here. we'll keep INC-2028-762 open for the postmortem. PR for policy patch: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/pulls/2219.

Lia: noted for postmortem: action items = (1) make cross-region fallback explicit in policy schema, (2) add telemetry & alert, (3) Console UX tweak, (4) e2e evals for fallback variants.

Jon: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
